skills.description: Find and run knowledge artifact tools, check dependencies, prepare the runtime and capture output files.
Create, inspect, update and validate editable Word DOCX documents, preserving source files and checking layout when needed.
Create, inspect, update and validate Excel workbooks, formulas, calculated values and native pivot tables.
Create, extract, overlay and validate PDFs, with rendered checks and explicit limits on document editing.
Create, inspect, update and validate editable PowerPoint decks, including native charts and rendered layout checks.
Create, read and update native Google Docs through an authorized connector, checking actual document identity and revisions.
Create, inspect and update native Google Sheets, including ranges, calculations and pivots supported by the granted connector.
Create, inspect and update native Google Slides through a granted connector while preserving presentation identity, layouts and permissions.
Split a large presentation into independently owned section specifications and assemble checked editable slides with one renderer.
Snapshot retrieved local sources with origin metadata, exact hashes and page, paragraph or cell anchors for later evidence checks.
Extract local PDF, DOCX and XLSX tables into reviewable records with source hashes and page, table or sheet locations.
Normalize local CSV data with explicit trim, null, type and duplicate policies while preserving identifiers and recording changes.
Evaluate reproducible arithmetic with named quantities, explicit units and assumptions using Pint, recording inputs and results.
Check source hashes, reproduced extraction anchors and exact quotations while keeping factual support and semantic review explicit.
Render document pages and presentation slides into inspectable previews, keeping rendering distinct from visual review.
Apply coherent visual hierarchy, typography, spacing and color to reports, presentations and other knowledge artifacts.
Choose truthful chart encodings with explicit units, uncertainty and source data, using editable charts where supported.
Create editable process, relationship and system diagrams using Mermaid or established drawing tools.
